articles.title: Judge clears path for Aave to move $71 million in ETH linked to North Korea hack
articles.snippet: Judge Margaret Garnett allowed frozen exploit funds on Arbitrum to move to Aave, but the legal freeze follows the assets as terrorism plaintiffs continue their claim.

articles.title: Court lets Arbitrum DAO transfer $71M in ETH tied to North Korea hack to Aave
articles.snippet: A Manhattan judge modified a restraining notice to let Arbitrum DAO move $71 million in frozen Ether to Aave, while preserving terrorism victims’ legal claim on the funds.
